endpoint_anchor_disclosure: All compared curves use the true observed start/end XY as anchors; intermediate-only metrics remove exact endpoint agreement.
limitations: Three correlated reserved windows from the same fixed-camera recording, with prior endpoint exposure. Optical path fidelity does not establish calibrated 3D, grasp/force/depth/timing recovery, or new-camera/object/real-robot generalization.

measurement_sensitivity.interpretation: Measurement perturbation only; not a confidence interval, retraining, bootstrap of independent episodes, or human action timing. Intermediate optical center coordinates vary; true endpoints remain fixed.

progress_interpretation: Observed normalized image-plane XY arc length; not human action timing
weighting: Each source has equal weight. Whole-path XY errors use observed arc-cell widths; intermediate errors exclude both endpoints and renormalize interior arc-cell widths within each source.
